entity: US count: 143 primary-care HPSAs first flagged 1978-89 still designated; 31 still severe
why: The pattern is covered: 73% of HPSA counties still short ten years on, and Paragon says many designations were never reviewed since the 1970s-80s (that's the MUA list). No source gives our count of 1978-89 HPSAs still flagged or the severe list.
